text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I decide to check out a sale
that caught
my attention.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
DAMMIT! I wasn't expectin' the
competition to be
this fierce...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Money's tight, and I can't afford to lose
out on
these deals. B-but this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, it's just you. Didn't expect to
see ya—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, I'm not backin' down! This
Umamusume isn't
goin' home till she's
got the goods!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, I'm not backin' down! This
Umamusume isn't
goin' home till she's
got the goods!
choice_data_list: ライバルをよく観察しよう
choice_data_list_en: Ride the flow of the crowd!
Let's ride the flow of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right! I gotta watch 'em just like
in my
races...
choice_data_list: ライバルをよく観察しよう
choice_data_list_en: Ride the flow of the crowd!
Let's ride the flow of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now's my chance! I'mma flank 'em from
the inside
and attack 'em real good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Take dat! Outta my way! I'll show ya
what an
Osaka shopper's really like!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... I thought I was gonna get crushed in there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But how's that for speed?! I left about fifteen other shoppers in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya better believe it! C'mon, lemme me
hear ya
say it again! Three cheers for
White Lightning!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's one way to approach it.
Time to
take a step back from the front
line!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The enemy knows my movements, so
they'll just
send me flyin' if I try to dive
in from the front.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I gotta be extra cautious with that older
lady in
the tiger stripes. That's Iron Wall
Michiyo, and
she's trouble.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She shuts out all her rivals' paths so no
one can
get through... All the regulars
know her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna avoid Michiyo and get to what
I want...
Then I've gotta go this way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A'ight, I'm gonna dive in! Watch and
learn,
rookie!
